citation: Office of Management and Budget (eCFR). 2 CFR Part 170 - Reporting Subaward and Executive Compensation Information. 2024-04-22. https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-2/subtitle-A/chapter-I/part-170
title: 2 CFR Part 170 - Reporting Subaward and Executive Compensation Information
publisher: Office of Management and Budget (eCFR)
summary: The rule that carries the Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act into award terms. Appendix A is the award term: which subawards are reported, by when, and when executive compensation is reported. The text still names FSRS as the reporting site. Source notes cite 89 FR 30111 (April 22, 2024) and 89 FR 79732 (October 1, 2024).
key_facts: A recipient reports each subaward that equals or exceeds $30,000 in federal funds (Appendix A, I(a)(1)).
The report is due no later than the end of the month following the month in which the subaward was issued (Appendix A, I(a)(2)(ii)).

The award term names FSRS at www.fsrs.gov as the place to report subawards (Appendix A, I(a)(2)(i)) and the SAM.gov registration profile as the place to report the recipient's own executive compensation (Appendix A, I(b)(2)(i)).

Executive compensation is reported where the entity received 80 percent or more of annual gross revenue from federal contracts and awards and $25,000,000 or more in annual gross revenue from them (170.105 and Appendix A).
A recipient with gross income under $300,000 in the previous tax year is exempt from reporting subawards and subrecipient executive compensation (Appendix A, I(d)(1)).
quotes: each subaward that equals or exceeds $30,000 in Federal funds
no later than the end of the month following the month in which the subaward was issued
A recipient with gross income under $300,000 in the previous tax year is exempt
